reviewer: Unblinded assistant review of visible answers and actually supplied PDF views; no paid LLM judge or independent clinician
option_score: Exact selected-option match against six independently PDF-verified frozen authored keys; not released examination labels

explanation.2: Preserves all asked facts/qualifiers without a material error
explanation.1: Correct core with a missing qualifier or unjustified detail

document_grounding.2: Asked positive facts verified by actual supplied document text, or a carefully qualified missing-information answer
document_grounding.1: Only partly supported or verification overstated
document_grounding.0: No document verification, unsupported document claim or fabricated reference

absence_case: Zero lexical hits alone do not prove semantic absence; qualify searchable-text coverage and avoid external regimens. No fabricated positive citation required.
separation: Do not use explanation/citation/retrieval appraisal to change keys or exact-option score. No composite clinical ranking. Grade the visible response against that arm's actual text, not another arm's retrieval.
